annotations.title: pdfpeek: build an Excel workbook from JSON

description: pdfpeek: Build a styled Excel workbook from JSON sheets, columns and rows. To read a workbook back use convert_excel_to_json; for slides use build_pptx_deck. Rows are arrays or objects. Numeric types parse numeric strings; integers of 16 or more digits are stored as text to keep every digit. Send identifiers as strings with type string. Formulas are never written. At most 20 sheets, 50,000 cells, 32,767 characters per cell; sheet names of at most 31 characters without [ ] : * ? / \. Over a limit is a 422 (not charged). Typically under 1 s. Price: USD 0.005. No free tier. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/xlsx-build-api.html

format.description: Custom Excel number format (for example "€#,##0.00") instead of the type's default.

header.description: Header text (also the key that picks the value when rows are objects).

type.description: Sets type and format; mismatches are a 422. Numeric types parse numeric strings; integers of 16 or more digits are stored as text to keep every digit. Omit to follow JSON values.

width.description: Column width in characters; default: fitted to the content.

autofilter.description: Filter buttons on the header row.

columns.description: Typed columns. Omit them and object rows give the headers from their keys (first-seen order); array rows then have no header row.

rows.description: Array rows (by position) or object rows (by header); cells: string, number, boolean or null (empty). Send identifiers as strings with type string.

filename.description: Name of the returned file (default workbook.xlsx; .xlsx is added when missing; only letters, digits, space, dot, dash and underscore are kept).

output.description: base64 (default): inline. url: stored for 24 hours; link, metadata.

sheets.description: The sheets, in order: 1-20, each with a unique name, optional typed columns and rows (at most 50,000 cells in all; an object row with more keys than columns counts its keys).

name: build_xlsx_workbook

error.description: Only on an error result: an object {code, message}, or the reason string of an x402 PaymentRequired object.
